source_type_decision.reason: The source asks how to diagnose and resolve an actual JVM OOM. A scenario contract is appropriate because a complete answer must classify the exhausted resource, preserve evidence, choose incident controls, distinguish leak from capacity pressure, state consistency/restart boundaries, and define validation rather than only describe JVM memory mechanisms.

primary_sources_checked.title: Oracle JDK 25: Troubleshoot Memory Leaks
verified_claims: OutOfMemoryError diagnosis must distinguish Java heap exhaustion from other memory/resource causes rather than assuming every OOM is a heap leak
heap-dump and Java Flight Recorder evidence can support memory-leak diagnosis, and trend/live-set evidence is needed to distinguish a leak from a sizing problem
JFR needs to be running when the relevant leak behavior occurs, which supports preparing continuous diagnostic evidence before an incident

primary_sources_checked.title: Oracle JDK 25: The java Command
verified_claims: -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError applies to OutOfMemoryError caused by Java heap exhaustion and not to other resource exhaustion such as native thread creation
-XX:HeapDumpPath controls the heap-dump destination when HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError is enabled
Native Memory Tracking is off by default and summary/detail are startup modes
JDK diagnostic tools should match the target JDK version where documented

primary_sources_checked.title: Oracle JDK 25: The jcmd Command
verified_claims: GC.class_histogram and GC.heap_dump are documented as high-impact operations whose impact depends on heap size/content
VM.native_memory exposes summary, detail, baseline, summary.diff and detail.diff operations
VM.metaspace is available for metaspace statistics and has documented runtime impact

primary_sources_checked.title: Oracle JDK 25: Native Memory Tracking
verified_claims: NMT tracks JVM/HotSpot internal native memory and does not cover third-party native code or all JDK class-library allocations
NMT is disabled by default, must be enabled with a JVM command-line option, and cannot be started or restarted later with jcmd
NMT supports an early baseline and later comparison

primary_sources_checked.title: Oracle JDK 25: The jfr Command
verified_claims: JFR files can be scrubbed to remove sensitive contents, supporting the candidate's treatment of diagnostic recordings as controlled artifacts

next_required_action: Bind the verified claims to an answer_evidence sidecar and run the deterministic candidate audit with --require-evidence. If that passes, obtain the mandatory pilot human approval before atomic promotion. Do not fabricate human review or promotion state.
